integrity: The lower bound is analytic and dimension-free. The finite checker verifies the order-eight Fano-plane core and independently constructs the order-twelve rank-ten spectral witness; it is not used as a substitute for the universal quotient argument.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the minimum cardinality of a binary spectral non-tile but not the minimum ambient dimension.
It does not classify spectral sets of cardinality \(16\) or larger.
An unindexed equivalent argument remains a residual originality risk.
title: Cardinality twelve is the sharp onset of binary spectral non-tiling
